2608.18723.title: Budget-First Tariff Recommendation (BFTR): A Complete Algorithmic Framework for Telecom Plan Recommendation without Overcharging
2608.18723.paper_summary: Telecom operators traditionally offer predefined tariff grids, forcing users to choose from a limited set of plans. This paper proposes BFTR (Budget-First Tariff Recommendation), a complete algorithmic framework integrating eight Budget-First strategies, including two original hybrid approaches: Recursive Hybrid (conditional interpolation) and Knapsack-First Hybrid (priority knapsack). Unlike existing approaches that adjust prices upward to guarantee a minimum margin, BFTR guarantees the absence of overcharging by systematically aligning the final price with the catalog reference price. We mathematically formalize each strategy, prove the existence of an offer for any positive budget, and prove that the price deviation (surcharge) is zero for all strategies that do not use interpolation with correction. A detailed comparative analysis confronts BFTR to ten main existing tariff models on ten dimensions. Experiments on a dataset of 974 customers inspired by the Nigerian MTN market show that: (i) Recursive Hybrid is optimal for the customer (100% budget used, 29.9 GB volume, utility 0.946, 0% overcharging), (ii) Piecewise offers the highest volume (39.7 GB) with 0% overcharging, (iii) Power Law provides an excellent compromise (99.9% budget, 38.1 GB, 0% overcharging). All strategies achieve a zero surcharge, confirming the theoretical guarantees. A sensitivity analysis on the weighting parameter alpha (0.2 - volume priority, 0.5 - balance, 0.8 - budget priority) shows that utility rankings evolve logically. Execution times (< 10 ms) and very low failure rates (0% for robust strategies) confirm the operational viability of the system. The formal proof of the absence of overcharging constitutes a major theoretical contribution.
2608.18723.paper_summary_zh: 電信運營商傳統上提供預定義的費率網格，迫使用戶從有限的計劃中選擇。本文提出了BFTR（預算優先費率推薦），這是一個完整的算法框架，整合了八種預算優先策略，包括兩種原創的混合方法：遞歸混合（條件插值）和背包優先混合（優先背包）。與現有的方法不同，BFTR通過系統性地將最終價格與目錄參考價格對齊，保證不會出現超收費。 我們數學上形式化了每種策略，證明了對於任何正預算都存在一個報價，並證明對於所有不使用帶修正的插值的策略，價格偏差（附加費）為零。詳細的比較分析將BFTR與十種主要現有費率模型在十個維度上進行對比。基於尼日利亞MTN市場的974名客戶數據集的實驗顯示：（i）遞歸混合對客戶是最佳的（100%預算使用，29.9 GB流量，效用0.946，0%超收費），（ii）分段提供了最高的流量（39.7 GB），且超收費為0%，（iii）冪律提供了極好的折衷（99.9%預算，38.1 GB，0%超收費）。所有策略都實現了零附加費，確認了理論保證。對權重參數alpha（0.2 - 流量優先，0.5 - 平衡，0.8 - 預算優先）的敏感性分析顯示效用排名邏輯上演變。執行時間（<10毫秒）和非常低的失敗率（穩健策略為0%）確認了系統的操作可行性。超收費不存在的正式證明構成了一個重要的理論貢獻。
